lead: Ronda Rousey is an American mixed martial arts fighter, born on 1 February 1987 in Santa Monica.
As of 2026, she is 39 years old, and her birth date places her under the Aquarius sign.
She has represented 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu and Cesar Gracie Jiu-Jitsu and has 10 credited works on public record.

sections.heading: Ronda Rousey — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Ronda Rousey was born on 1 February 1987 in Santa Monica, and holds American nationality. She was given the name Ronda Jean Rousey at birth and is publicly known as Ronda Rousey.
Public records name her mother, AnnMaria De Mars. She is a sibling of Maria Burns Otiz.
She received her education at Santa Monica High School.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Ronda Rousey — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists mixed martial arts fighter, judoka, professional wrestler, martial artist, actor and athlete as her occupations, including work with Ultimate Fighting Championship, WWE and All Elite Wrestling.
On the team sheet, Ronda has been associated with 10th Planet Jiu-Jitsu and Cesar Gracie Jiu-Jitsu.
She has taken part in 2004 Summer Olympics, 2004 Summer Olympics, UFC 157, UFC 168 and UFC 170.
